## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag the kind(s) of a [`gmeow:ServiceOffering`](../classes/gmeow-ServiceOffering.md) by referencing [`gmeow:ServiceType`](../classes/gmeow-ServiceType.md) value individuals — consulting, hosting, support.

### Avoid when

- Avoid expressing the kind as a subclass (it is a value — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid forcing one kind; a service offering may carry several.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:serviceType`](gmeow-serviceType.md) triples to a [`gmeow:ServiceOffering`](../classes/gmeow-ServiceOffering.md) referencing [`gmeow:ServiceType`](../classes/gmeow-ServiceType.md) individuals; projects to [schema:serviceType.](https://schema.org/serviceType.)

### Examples

- ex:hostingService [`gmeow:serviceType`](gmeow-serviceType.md) ex:serviceTypeHosting.
